llm.summary: This skill openly guides a user through Structs combat transactions and does not contain hidden code or deceptive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is combat, raids, defense, stealth, and positioning in Structs, and the documented transaction commands fit that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill repeatedly tells the agent to verify targets and rely on CLI confirmations, with one clearly disclosed prompt-suppressed raid compute flow gated by an approval checklist.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only SKILL.md and _meta.json, with no executable installer or bundled scripts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It requires structsd and a configured signing key, which is high-impact but expected for a Structs transaction helper and disclosed in the instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Raid compute may run for minutes to hours and auto-submit completion, but this is explicitly described as part of the raid workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to help with real Structs transactions. Verify the structsd binary, signing key, target IDs, guild boundaries, gas settings, and any use of -y before allowing actions, and monitor long-running raid compute until it completes.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The command-ship move command is present in the command reference and positioning guidance, so it is disclosed and coherent with the combat-positioning purpose rather than hidden behavior.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the artifact being instruction-only markdown plus metadata.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry is pending and does not add a negative artifact-backed signal.
